title: Investigating the Utility of Multimodal Conversational Technology and Audiovisual Analytic Measures for the Assessment and Monitoring of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis at Scale
reasoning: The paper is a technical investigation into a medical technology for assessing Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS). It analyzes acoustic and visual data for diagnostic and monitoring purposes. There is no discussion, evaluation, or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
